title: Fix DevServerBootstrap app background in light theme
body:
Addresses an issue where the `DevServerBootstrap` application background in light mode mistakenly used the dark/blue gradient (`--uv-bg`) that is only intended for the Unity viewport.

- Added `--uv-app-bg` variable to `ThemeConfig.ts` (white for light mode, dark gray for dark mode).
- Updated `index.html` `body`, `main`, and `.loading-container` styles to use `--uv-app-bg`.
- Updated `DevServerBootstrap.ts` to use `--uv-app-bg` for gallery preview card headers.
